subject: reactiveFileReader() not catching changes in local app folder

messages.author: af2b60295205d4cb
messages.subject: reactiveFileReader() not catching changes in local app folder
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if somebody could help me with this. The goal of the app is to build a plot of some data and whenever changes are made to the csv file in the local app folder (stored on my computer), the reactiveFileReader() in my deployed app on Shinyapps.io would automatically catch the changes and refresh the plot. In the Gallery example of this function a process writes to logfile online, but I wasn't able to find an example with a local file being updated, so I'm hoping to get an answer here.

Here's my code for server.R file for a Shiny app.

#server.R
require(rCharts)
shinyServer(
  function(input, output, session) {
       hours <- reactiveFileReader(1000, session, 'data/hours.csv', read.csv)
          output$chart1 <- renderChart({
          HoursPlot <- hPlot(x="Manager", y="HoursLogged", type="bar", data=hours(), title = "Hours Logged This Month")
          HoursPlot$yAxis(title = list(text = "Hours Logged")) 
          HoursPlot$addParams(height = 600, dom = 'chart1')
          return(HoursPlot)
          })
        
  }
)

#ui.R

require(rCharts)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Manager Hours Logged"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
    helpText("This is a trial of reactiveFileReader() function in Shiny")
  ),
  mainPanel(
    showOutput("chart1", "highcharts")
  )
))
)

According to the manual of reactiveFileReader this placement of the function inside shinyServer() will make it work per-session, and it actually works great inside RStudio (I have Windows): every time I make changes to the hours.csv file in data folder, it instantly updates the chart in RStudio. However, once deployed on Shinyapps.io it only shows static data (what was originally in hours.csv), it doesn't seem to update reactively as it should. I know if I re-deploy the app, the data will be refreshed, but what's the point of reactiveFileReader() then? I would really like for it to work properly, and if I place this function outside of shinyServer() (above the call), it will load for a second and shut down, which is not acceptable obviously.


Thanks in advance for your help!
